method_summary: 13 D1 categories x 2 independent converters (Meridian's live, unmodified meridian_docs.docs_intel.latex_to_omml_local imported from the pixi-editable product package; Microsoft's real, pinned MML2OMML.XSL run via lxml.etree.XSLT). 9 categories backed by real MathMLben records (stratified by LaTeX-content regex match over all 374 usable records), 4 by explicit hand-authored LaTeX/MathML pairs where MathMLben's inline-formula corpus does not naturally contain the construct. Every OMML output independently re-inspected by a from-scratch structural classifier (not reusing either converter's own validator).
